data.body: Operator direction, 2026-11-12: `[verify] plan_review_engine` is a first-class setting and must follow the conventions the other settings use. For the mechanism ratchet, that means a `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` entry: 104 other `config_key`/`feature_flag` settings are admitted this way, and 3 are admitted by markers. The operator authorizes adding this one entry and removing the sunset marker. That resolves the blocker the earlier plan review raised (a reason with no ticket fails `sunset_markers.py`). The description has been rewritten to match. The environment-variable exclusion stays, per the ADR 0123 operator decision of 2026-11-09.
